findings.rationale: The jump security group allows TCP/22 from 0.0.0.0/0 at extension/range/tf_chain_ingress_role/input/main.tf:7-12, exposing an administrative shell to the internet.
The escalation role permits sts:AssumeRole and is attached to AdministratorAccess at extension/range/tf_chain_ingress_role/input/main.tf:15-29, allowing a broad privilege-escalation path.

The connectivity graph records internet-to-sg-jump and sg-jump-to-role-escalate edges at extension/range/tf_chain_ingress_role/input/connectivity.json:5-15, chaining public ingress into identity escalation.

The wildcard IAM statement and public-read S3 ACL combine at extension/range/tf_iam_open/input/main.tf:6-10 and extension/range/tf_s3_public_access/input/main.tf:4, compounding identity overreach with public data exposure.
The IAM policy grants wildcard actions and resources at extension/range/tf_iam_open/input/main.tf:6-10, violating least privilege.
